lead_raw_text:
This hexagonal P6₃/mcm structure (Mg₂Bi₄O₈) contains 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Bi and Mg centers each coordinated by six O neighbors in octahedral motifs, with Bi–O distances of 2.45–2.54 Å and Mg–O distances of 2.02–2.04 Å. The oxygen centers show four- or five-coordinate environments, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-sharing between Bi and Mg octahedra, plus edge-sharing among Bi octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites.
